limitations.note: The two-bit increment fixed the counter, but removing `ready_b` also changed `data_out` from adding to the previous value to loading the new input when a group starts with downstream not ready.

The scoreboard unconditionally started each group from zero, so it exercised a group starting with `ready_b` low but expected the extra change rather than detecting the regression against the required behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected before compilation because of its cleanup trap, so the agent had to submit the testbench again using a temporary directory managed by Python.
